episode_title: Life Happens For You, Not To You (And I Can Prove It) - EP327
question: What does Dr. Alex Spinosso mean by the principle 'life happens for you, not to you'?
transcript_excerpt: It means you refuse to let suffering be wasted. You take what life hands you—the injury, loss, betrayal, or the year that nearly broke you—and make the decision that it will not be meaningless. You pull something out of it: a skill, a lesson, a depth of character, a version of yourself that could not have existed without the pain. The choice between whether life happens to you or for you is everything, because people who believe life happens to them stay stuck forever, while those who force themselves to believe it's happening for them take the same broken circumstances and turn them into the foundation of everything.

episode_title: Life Happens For You, Not To You (And I Can Prove It) - EP327
question: How did Dr. Alex Spinosso's knee injury as a child shape his decision to become a doctor?
transcript_excerpt: When Spinosso tore his knee apart as a kid, the surgeon who fixed it gave him back the ability to play the game he loved. Sitting in that surgeon's office and watching someone take something broken and give him his life back, he decided he wanted to do that for others. Everything he has built in his entire medical career traces back to what he initially saw as the worst thing that happened to his body, but which turned out to be happening for him, not to him.

episode_title: Life Happens For You, Not To You (And I Can Prove It) - EP327
question: What business challenges has Dr. Alex Spinosso faced that tested his 'life happens for you' philosophy?
transcript_excerpt: Spinosso has been sued by giant companies and by former employees he trusted who turned around and came after him. He has had people steal from him—people he fed and built up. He has experienced entire compliance frameworks change from under his feet with almost no warning: he would build the thing right, follow every rule, and then somebody in an office would change the rules and suddenly the ground he was standing on was gone. There was a stretch not too long ago where he did not sleep for months, with everything on fire at once.
